structure.unit: Relocation Assistance and Real Property Acquisition Policies

law.catch_line: Optional moving expense allowance for persons displaced from dwelling
law.text: Any displaced person eligible for payments under § 25.1-406 who is displaced from a dwelling may elect to accept the payments authorized by this section in lieu of the payments authorized by § 25.1-406, which displaced person so electing shall receive a moving expense allowance of an amount determined according to a schedule established by the state agency. The acceptance of the payment authorized by this section shall be in lieu of any payment under § 25.1-406.
